title: Now Follows the Episode of Kullu

blocks.text: The miraculous cage descends safely at the Mandi boundary, where Sidh Sain and the Sikhs rush out in relief and receive Banda with flowers and honor.
His fame rises still further as the story of his release spreads, and forts, camps, and oversight in the hill country begin to gather around him in legend-like form.
The Mandi boundary marks the transition from threatened captivity back to honored authority.
